# Women In Tools

ATG is a great place for women to build a dynamic career.  With professional development and
opportunities to grow, the potential is a click away.

[Learn More][63]
 
 

# Join Our Team

ATG is a lean, innovative and inclusive team where every idea counts. Your creativity, passion and
know-how can accelerate our success. Join us to build the career you’ve always wanted.

[Learn More][64]
 
 

# Electronics

We make the tools needed to support the design, testing, manufacturing and repair of the latest
electronics innovations -- from smart phones and tablets to video game consoles and e-readers.

[Learn More][65]
 
 

# Construction / DIY

We provide contractors with durable and dependable tools for material handling, framing, surveying,
inspecting, and many build/rebuild tasks.

[Learn More][66]
 
 

# Motor Vehicle Industry

We provide the fastening solutions global motor vehicle manufacturers need to ensure superior
quality production.

[Learn More][67]
 
 

# Industrial

With a reputation dating back more than 100 years, we provide tools and equipment for preventative
machine maintenance, production, and parts assembly at the most demanding industrial facilities and
production and parts assembly at manufacturing plants around the globe.

[Learn More][68]
 
 

# Vehicle Service

We offer a wide array of professional hand and power tools to the global service industry. In this
market that relies largely on manual labor, we know that time is money.

[Learn More][69]
 
 

# Aerospace

Built with the stringent standards of the aerospace technician in mind, our tools improve
productivity and ensure strength and precision during the assembly process.

[Learn More][70]
 

# ATG’s Master Brands

Apex Tool Group manufactures leading hand and power tool brands around the world.

# Women In Tools

ATG is a great place for women to build a dynamic career.  With professional development and
opportunities to grow, the potential is a click away.

[Learn More][63]
 
 

# Join Our Team

ATG is a lean, innovative and inclusive team where every idea counts. Your creativity, passion and
know-how can accelerate our success. Join us to build the career you’ve always wanted.

[Learn More][64]
 
 

# Electronics

We make the tools needed to support the design, testing, manufacturing and repair of the latest
electronics innovations -- from smart phones and tablets to video game consoles and e-readers.

[Learn More][65]
 
 

# Construction / DIY

We provide contractors with durable and dependable tools for material handling, framing, surveying,
inspecting, and many build/rebuild tasks.

[Learn More][66]
 
 

# Motor Vehicle Industry

We provide the fastening solutions global motor vehicle manufacturers need to ensure superior
quality production.

[Learn More][67]
 
 

# Industrial

With a reputation dating back more than 100 years, we provide tools and equipment for preventative
machine maintenance, production, and parts assembly at the most demanding industrial facilities and
production and parts assembly at manufacturing plants around the globe.

[Learn More][68]
 
 

# Vehicle Service

We offer a wide array of professional hand and power tools to the global service industry. In this
market that relies largely on manual labor, we know that time is money.

[Learn More][69]
 
 

# Aerospace

Built with the stringent standards of the aerospace technician in mind, our tools improve
productivity and ensure strength and precision during the assembly process.

[Learn More][70]
 

# ATG’s Master Brands

Apex Tool Group manufactures leading hand and power tool brands around the world.

hose/instrumentation accessories. We carry over 160,000 unique parts across many styles and sizes,
and we can build custom solutions when you need them. 

*Our mission is to provide best-in-class hydraulic, pneumatic, and instrumentation products,
leveraging our extensive inventories with a consultative approach.*

## Snap-on makes work easier for professionals performing critical tasks.



## Rooted in the dignity of work, guided with insight shaped
## from experience.



## 
## 
## Snap-on provides a broad array
## of unique productivity solutions.



## Precision. Performance. Pride.



## Snap-on supports a wide range of serious professionals in critical industries.

## Spotlight on Snap-on

### NPR: Federal Reserve looks for 'secret sauce' behind a successful Wisconsin toolmaker.

*"Our philosophy is to be at the point of work, observing it, and figuring out what are the most
sticky tasks. And then using those insights to create a tool which will make it easier." -Nick
Pinchuk, Snap-on Chairman and CEO.*

Scott Horsley from NPR recently visited Snap-on headquarters in Kenosha, Wisconsin, alongside
Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago President Austan Goolsbee to learn what drives our success. The
answer starts with listening to professionals, understanding their work, and delivering solutions
that help them be more productive every day.

**Read more in NPR's feature article**: [Federal Reserve looks for 'secret sauce' behind Wisconsin
toolmaker Snap-on : NPR][98]

## 
##

## Precision. Performance. Pride.

## Spotlight on Snap-on

### NPR: Federal Reserve looks for 'secret sauce' behind a successful Wisconsin toolmaker.

*"Our philosophy is to be at the point of work, observing it, and figuring out what are the most
sticky tasks. And then using those insights to create a tool which will make it easier." -Nick
Pinchuk, Snap-on Chairman and CEO.*

Scott Horsley from NPR recently visited Snap-on headquarters in Kenosha, Wisconsin, alongside
Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago President Austan Goolsbee to learn what drives our success. The
answer starts with listening to professionals, understanding their work, and delivering solutions
that help them be more productive every day.

**Read more in NPR's feature article**: [Federal Reserve looks for 'secret sauce' behind Wisconsin
toolmaker Snap-on : NPR][98]

## Your destination for business supplies, equipment, and tools

Shop at Zoro and find millions of premium products from thousands of trusted brands, including
tools, office supplies, industrial equipment, safety products, and much more. Discover everything
you need to keep your business running at one convenient online supplier, with free shipping on
orders over $50 when you sign in or sign up for an account. Count on great perks that make your
shopping experience even easier, including Net 30 terms and tax-exempt purchases for qualifying
customers, no-hassle returns, and excellent U.S.-based customer service from people who truly care.

As a leader in the maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) industry, Zoro carries the hard-to-find
products, tools, equipment, and replacement parts you need to support your business, facility, or
warehouse, no matter your size—from small to medium-sized companies to large enterprises. Shop our
huge selection of hand and power tools from top brands like Milwaukee, DeWalt, Stanley, Westward,
and so many more. Keep your facility and employees safe with personal protective equipment (PPE)
including eye protection, gloves and hand protection, as well as fire protection and lockout/tagout
products. You’ll also find plumbing equipment, electrical supplies, heating and cooling parts and
products, and so much more. With over 12 million products and counting, we are constantly adding to
our endless assortment, so you can find the products you need, when you need them, and get them
shipped fast.

## Your destination for business supplies, equipment, and tools

Shop at Zoro and find millions of premium products from thousands of trusted brands, including
tools, office supplies, industrial equipment, safety products, and much more. Discover everything
you need to keep your business running at one convenient online supplier, with free shipping on
orders over $50 when you sign in or sign up for an account. Count on great perks that make your
shopping experience even easier, including Net 30 terms and tax-exempt purchases for qualifying
customers, no-hassle returns, and excellent U.S.-based customer service from people who truly care.

As a leader in the maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) industry, Zoro carries the hard-to-find
products, tools, equipment, and replacement parts you need to support your business, facility, or
warehouse, no matter your size—from small to medium-sized companies to large enterprises. Shop our
huge selection of hand and power tools from top brands like Milwaukee, DeWalt, Stanley, Westward,
and so many more. Keep your facility and employees safe with personal protective equipment (PPE)
including eye protection, gloves and hand protection, as well as fire protection and lockout/tagout
products. You’ll also find plumbing equipment, electrical supplies, heating and cooling parts and
products, and so much more. With over 12 million products and counting, we are constantly adding to
our endless assortment, so you can find the products you need, when you need them, and get them
shipped fast.

# Excellence and innovation built into every design.

We Airmax Pneumatics Ltd are a part of the vast and ever-growing valve industry since 1992. Being
one of the leading and profound pneumatic valve manufacturer based in India, we boast of a wide
range of Pneumatic Cylinders, Directional Control Valves, Rotary Joints & FRL Units in various sizes
with various Features. Dedication to detail, Belief in hard work and an urge to customers
satisfaction are the keys that play the most important role to our valuable team.

CERTIFICATION
Why Choose
Airmax Pneumatics?

Airmax Pneumatics prioritizes quality and customer satisfaction by adhering to rigorous industry
standards. Their commitment is evident through their achievement of certifications like ISO and CE,
specifically for their pneumatic valve and cylinder products. These certifications demonstrate that
Airmax Pneumatics follows internationally recognized best practices in design, manufacturing, and
quality control.

Air Piping Direct is your premier destination for all things related to air piping solutions. With a
focus on providing top-quality products and comprehensive services, we cater to a wide range of

solutions, we have you covered.

boasts over a decade of experience not only in selling air piping products but also in their
application & use. From initial consultation to installation and beyond, we're here to support you
every step of the way.

tools to optimize your air piping setup for efficiency and productivity. We understand that every
project is unique, and we tailor our solutions to meet your specific requirements.

At Air Piping Direct, customer service is paramount. When you reach out to us, you'll be connected
with one of our knowledgeable air piping specialists who will guide you through product selection,
installation procedures, maintenance tips, and more. Your satisfaction is our priority, and we're
dedicated to helping you achieve success with your air piping projects.

Whether you're a small business, industrial facility, or commercial enterprise, trust Air Piping
Direct to deliver superior products, expertise, and support for all your air piping needs. Contact
us today to experience the difference firsthand.

## Air Piping Parts, Consultation, Install, 3D Mapping & More

Air Piping Direct is your premier destination for all things related to air piping solutions. With a
focus on providing top-quality products and comprehensive services, we cater to a wide range of
industries and applications requiring efficient and reliable air piping systems.

Our extensive product range includes pipes, fittings, valves, accessories, and more, renowned for
their durability and performance. Whether you're looking for standard components or specialized
solutions, we have you covered.

What sets us apart is our commitment to customer satisfaction and expertise in the field. Our team
boasts over a decade of experience not only in selling air piping products but also in their
application & use. From initial consultation to installation and beyond, we're here to support you
every step of the way.

Need assistance with system design or 3D mapping? Our experts are equipped with the knowledge and
tools to optimize your air piping setup for efficiency and productivity. We understand that every
project is unique, and we tailor our solutions to meet your specific requirements.

At Air Piping Direct, customer service is paramount. When you reach out to us, you'll be connected
with one of our knowledgeable air piping specialists who will guide you through product selection,
installation procedures, maintenance tips, and more. Your satisfaction is our priority, and we're
dedicated to helping you achieve success with your air piping projects.

Whether you're a small business, industrial facility, or commercial enterprise, trust Air Piping
Direct to deliver superior products, expertise, and support for all your air piping needs. Contact
us today to experience the difference firsthand.

# Technology that transforms the future

We develop ideas and technologies that enable our customers to grow and drive society forward. This
is how we transform the future.

[Wind turbines against the sunset.]
[

Careers

## Available jobs

Browse jobs based on your location and ambitions.

][178]
[

Investors

### Reports and presentations

Explore quarterly and annual reports and presentations.

][179]
[

Media

### Press releases

Find our latest press releases.

][180]

People Podcast

## Careers without ladders

The latest episode of People Podcast explores how career growth is becoming more flexible,
skills-driven and non-linear, and what it means to take ownership of your next move.

[Listen to People Podcast][181]
[People Podcast banner with Cecilia Sandberg and Jessica Clarke ]

## Solutions for real challenges and needs

We develop technologies and solutions that are key to our customers’ success. You will find our
customers in most industries and across the globe.

### About us

Most likely, we play a larger part in your everyday life than you realise. Get to know us to find
out how. 

[Get to know us][182]
[Innovation banner image - people]

### Our brands

With many brands that offer cutting-edge innovations and solutions for specific customer segments,
we deliver maximum value.

[Browse all our brands][183]

### Business areas

From air compressors to vacuum pumps, to power tools and light towers – our technologies come in
many forms.

[See what business areas we work with][184]
[A man and woman in lab coats with focused looks on their faces working on something together.]

Sustainability

## Part of the transformation to a low-carbon society

We are committed to being part of the solution for a better tomorrow. By being accountable for our
impact and by acting in an ethical way in all our business relationships, we strive to bring value
to both all our stakeholders and society as a whole.

[Go to our sustainability approach][185]

## Recent press releases

### President and CEO comments on Q2 report

July 16, 2026

Q3 Press Release 2026 Financial reports

Nacka, Sweden, July 16, 2026: Vagner Rego, President and CEO of Atlas Copco Group, comments on the
quarterly report for Q2 that was released today.


### Second-quarter report 2026

July 16, 2026

Q3 Press Release 2026 Regulatory releases

Record order intake, solid revenue and profit growth  


### Chinese heating and cooling equipment manufacturer to become part of Atlas Copco Group

July 15, 2026

Q3 Press Release 2026 Acquisitions

Nacka, Sweden, July 15, 2026: Guangdong Euroklimat Air-Conditioning & Refrigeration Co., Ltd
(“Guangdong Euroklimat”) a Chinese manufacturer of industrial heating and cooling solutions will
become part of Atlas Copco Group.


### Atlas Copco Group receives prestigious award for industrial assembly tool

July 8, 2026

Miscellaneous Q3 Press Release 2026 Product info

Nacka, Sweden, July 8, 2026: Atlas Copco Group has received the 2026 Red Dot Design Award for its XB
range of industrial assembly tools.


[View all press releases][186]

Browse available jobs and filter based on your location and desired role. With many opportunities

Innovation

### Great ideas drive development

Welcoming new ideas and challenging the status quo are key to our innovation. It leads to continuous
refinements – as well as great leaps forward.
[Explore our innovations][192]
[Technician in goggles and orange jacket operating a machine]

## There is always a better way

Learn about some of the ways in which we discover and implement better ways of doing things. 

View as carousel
View as grid

### Leak detection: The hidden hero of high tech

Vacuum is essential in many industries, including semiconductors, food and beverage, refrigeration,
energy storage and pharmaceuticals. And wherever there is vacuum there is leak detection.
[Read about our leak detection systems][193]
[Leak detection technology - pipes]

### Avoiding emissions through clever choices

Smart and highly efficient solutions from Atlas Copco Group help industries reduce their greenhouse
gas emissions.
[How we help industries reduce their climate impact][194]
[Technicians in conversation in front of field of solar panels]

### A smarter approach to medical air supply

Hospitals can now upgrade their medical air systems with the TotalAlert 360 controller that makes it
easier to understand, easier to monitor, and faster to troubleshoot.
[Watch video about TA 360 controller][195]

customers in most industries and across the globe.

out how.

# **Covered calls**

are an easy and conservative income-oriented investment strategy.
Use our [covered call screener][15] to earn extra income from stocks and ETFs you already own,
or to help find new investment opportunities selling the [best covered calls][16].

## I already own stocks
## to write calls against.

Earn extra income by writing call options on your existing portfolio.

[Portfolio][17]

## I'm looking for new
## buy-write opportunities.

Search today's 888,367 covered calls with our easy-to-use interface.

[Search][18]

## I need a little help...
## show me the tutorial.

Learn how to use covered call options to generate recurring income.

[Tutorial][19]

## Why covered calls?

> The covered call strategy is conservative in nature, consistent in its ability to generate
> recurring monthly income, and simple to execute.
> 
> The facts show that [most stock options held until expiration expire worthless][20].
> 
> [Selling options to other people][21] is how many professional traders make a good living. We're
> here to make it easier for average investors to do just that.
> 
> Anyone who owns stock can sell covered calls against their shares for extra income. [Multiple
> studies][22] have shown that covered calls are superior to the popular buy-and-hold strategy.

## Why Born To Sell?

People like us.

> Barron's: "A terrific tool for those who generate income by selling calls against existing
> positions. Born To Sell gives covered call traders some great ideas."
> 
> TheStreet.com: "One of the best covered call tools I have come across in a long time."
> 
> [click here to read dozens of additional reviews...][23]

Our software is fast.

> If you change one of our Search filters (any slider, checkbox, etc.) you see the results update
> immediately. You never have to push a Search button and wait for an entire new page load to see
> the results.

Our software is easy.

> We use modern web design principles to make your choices clear and easy to understand. It is our
> belief that you can make money with covered calls by keeping the software and process simple.

Our software saves you time.

> Most covered call writers spend a great deal of time creating and updating a custom spreadsheet
> they use to track their positions. Our Portfolio features take care of this for you.
> 
> For example, our Dashboard lets you see at a glance how much time premium remains in each of your
> positions so you can quickly decide if it's time to modify or exit any of them. You'll also get a
> Personal Calendar with earnings release dates and ex-dividend dates for all your positions. And
> our Top 10 page shows you the most popular covered calls. Plus [weeklys][24], updating prices
> during market hours, [rolling calculator][25], income goal, etc... [Check out our features][26].

Our software is award winning.

> 1st place for Trading Software in the STAR Award contest for [3 years][27].

We have a free trial.

> You can try everything we have [free for two weeks][28]. We're confident you'll like what you see.
> And if not... well, maybe you could try to eat some ice cream and then come back when you're in a
> better mood.

Distill continuously monitors news coverage, press releases, company blogs, and LinkedIn posts — so

## Frequently asked questions

Which companies can I track with Distill?

You can track **any company, globally**, regardless of whether they are public or private. Unlike
traditional finance tools that rely on stock ticker symbols, Distill allows you to track early-stage
startups, private companies, and niche international players just as easily as Fortune 500
companies. If the company exists and has a website, Distill can track it.

What sources does Distill track?

Distill provides a complete picture by combining **media coverage** with **official company
sources**. We monitor:
* **Major media outlets** and trusted industry news sites.
* **Local and regional news publications**.
* **Official company channels**, including press releases, blogs, and investor relations pages.
* **Medium and Substack feeds**.
* **LinkedIn company posts** to catch product launches and leadership updates often missed by the
  press.

How is Distill different from Google Alerts?

Google Alerts provides a raw list of links, often resulting in cluttered inboxes and repetitive
headlines. Distill is an **intelligence engine**. It uses AI to:
* **Group sources**: If a story is covered by 20 outlets, we group them into a single card so you

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals
  Hiring
  Field sales push
  12 AE roles, 3 metros
  Product
  New API surface
  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.
Testimonials

## What our customers are saying
* ### Knowing where to look
  
  "A competitor quietly sunsetted a feature — no announcement, no changelog, no blog post. The only
  trace was a small edit buried in their developer docs. ForesightIQ flagged it."
  
  [Mitch Eger]
  Mitch EgerProduct Marketing Manager, Polygon Labs
* ### Signals incumbent tools miss
  
  "Crayon missed an entire Square ads campaign. ForesightIQ caught it — screenshots and all — and
  it's directly shaped how our Brand team positioned our next campaign."
  
  [Min Chi]
  Min ChiSenior Manager, Insights, Public SaaS Company
* ### Future focused insights
  
  "ForesightIQ isn't a rearview mirror. It shows me where companies are headed next."
  
  [Marco Burgarello]
  Marco BurgarelloGTM Leader, Nextiva

Sources

## Beyond the usual sources

We monitor the hidden sources everyone misses plus integrate custom sources specific to your
industry.

# Ultimate Online Gamepad Tester

Check your controller buttons, drift, vibration, microphone and audio channels. No download
required. Works with Xbox, PS4, PS5, and generic USB devices.

Status: Ready

Click the buttons below to verify left and right channels.

Start Auto Loop

#### Left Channel

440Hz Sine Wave

🔊 C

#### Center / Both

550Hz Sine Wave

🔊 R

#### Right Channel

660Hz Sine Wave

### Dead Pixel & Touch Test

Enter full screen mode to check for dead pixels or test touchscreen responsiveness. Click/Tap
anywhere to exit color mode.

AUTO

#### Instructions
* Select a color to fill the screen.
* Look closely for pixels that don't match the background (stuck or dead pixels).
* Drag your finger across the screen to test touch continuity.
* Press ESC or Click to exit.

## Features Overview

⚡

### Instant Detection

Uses the HTML5 Gamepad API for zero-latency detection of connected devices via USB or Bluetooth.

🎮

### Universal Support

Mapped for Standard Gamepad layouts including Xbox 360/One, PS4 DualShock, PS5 DualSense, and Switch
Pro.

🔍

### Drift Analysis

Visual stick axes allow you to see stick drift or deadzones in real-time with high precision values.

## How to Test Your Gamepad

1

#### Connect Device

Plug in your controller via USB or pair via Bluetooth.

2

#### Press Any Button

Modern browsers require user interaction to detect the device for security.

3

#### Check Inputs

Watch the visualizer above. Verify that every button lights up and sticks move smoothly.

## Frequently Asked Questions

My controller isn't showing up?+
Most browsers require you to press a button on the controller before it becomes visible to the
website. Try pressing A/X or moving a stick. Also ensure your drivers are installed if on Windows 7.
Does vibration test work on all devices?+
Vibration support depends on your browser and OS. Chrome on Windows usually supports Rumble. Firefox
and macOS often have limited or no support for haptic feedback in the browser.
How do I fix stick drift?+
This tool helps diagnose drift. If the visual stick isn't centered when you aren't touching it, you
have drift. You can try cleaning the sensor with compressed air or adjusting deadzones in your game
settings.
Is this tool free?+
Yes, GamepadTester.dev is completely free and open for everyone to use.

## Latest Guides

A guide to cleaning and repairing PS5 controllers.

Comparison of input lag over Bluetooth vs Wired.

Top rated controllers for competitive gaming.

[Read more →][4]TUTORIAL

#### Calibrate in Windows

How to use the built-in Windows calibration tool.

[Read more →][5]
Click to Exit

The trusted online platform for precise testing of controllers and peripherals — built for gamers,

My controller isn't showing up?+

Vibration support depends on your browser and OS. Chrome on Windows usually supports Rumble. Firefox
and macOS often have limited or no support for haptic feedback in the browser.
How do I fix stick drift?+
This tool helps diagnose drift. If the visual stick isn't centered when you aren't touching it, you
have drift. You can try cleaning the sensor with compressed air or adjusting deadzones in your game
settings.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

### Standards

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

What is guns.lol?
guns.lol is a link-in-bio platform that helps you share everything you do in one clean, customizable
page. It's built to be faster, more aesthetic, and more powerful than platforms like Linktree, and
it even includes an image host for sharing images and videos instantly.
Is guns.lol free?
Yes! guns.lol is completely free to use. You can also upgrade to Premium to unlock advanced
customization, extended analytics, and exclusive profile badges.
What can I do with guns.lol?
Create a personalized bio page that links all your socials, websites, and projects in one spot. You
can also upload and share images or short videos directly through the built-in image host, perfect
for creators who want everything in one ecosystem.
Why use guns.lol over other link-in-bio tools?
guns.lol is faster, sleeker, and built for creators who care about design and privacy. No ads, no
tracking clutter, just a clean, modern experience that makes your online identity stand out.
Is guns.lol safe?
Yes. Over 2,090,000 users trust guns.lol to host their profiles and media securely. We use encrypted
connections, modern infrastructure, and strict moderation to protect your data and prevent abuse.
How long does setup take?
Less than a minute. Sign up, add your links, customize your page, and start sharing instantly.

Our triple action patented venturi uses side ports to combine free ambient air with compressed air,
creating a fuller volume of usable output. This feature-packed blow gun outperforms its overpriced
competitors.

[features][features]

## SAFETY COMPLIANT

Exceeds OSHA requirements by reducing compressed air pressure to less than 30 psi when dead-ended
and by providing required safety shield for effective chip guarding. KMS Safety Blow Guns tested
using 125 psi initial pressure put out approximately 20 psi nozzle pressure when blocked. Protective
shield guards operator from blown debris and prevents lever from activating when dropped. Venturi
side ports provide safety relief when blow gun is dead-ended.

[instruction][instruction]

Many managers have observed operators plugging or taping over their blow guns’ vent holes in an
effort to increase output. If the venturi side ports of a KMS Safety Blow Gun are blocked, the
airflow output is very noticeably reduced, thus eliminating the tamper incentive and preventing
safety violations.

Exceeds OSHA requirements by reducing compressed air pressure to less than 30 psi when dead-ended
and by providing required safety shield for effective chip guarding. KMS Safety Blow Guns tested
using 125 psi initial pressure put out approximately 20 psi nozzle pressure when blocked. Protective
shield guards operator from blown debris and prevents lever from activating when dropped. Venturi
side ports provide safety relief when blow gun is dead-ended.

[instruction][instruction]

## TAMPERPROOF

Many managers have observed operators plugging or taping over their blow guns’ vent holes in an
effort to increase output. If the venturi side ports of a KMS Safety Blow Gun are blocked, the
airflow output is very noticeably reduced, thus eliminating the tamper incentive and preventing
safety violations.

Milton® provides many industries the most high-quality, reliable and comprehensive range of
hydraulic-driven system components

## HYDRAULIC COUPLERS

Our hydraulic couplers are the ultimate solution for any high demanding industrial application and
are crafted of a high-grade carbon steel to provide a reliable, leak-free, connection. ISO
1440/16028 Certified*

[ VIEW PRODUCTS ][47]

High-grade fittings that provide added durability, safety, and greater reliability by significantly
reducing the risk of over torquing and leaks. – SAE Compliant*

[ VIEW PRODUCTS ][48]

Providing a broad portfolio of hose assemblies to reach all customers desired specifications. – SAE
Compliant* (Made to Order – Upon Request)

Ensure your pneumatic system has all the necessary accessories & tools to operate to peak
performance while completing those demanding projects.

## Frequently Asked Questions
* ### What is Netflix?
  
  Netflix is a streaming service that offers a wide variety of award-winning TV shows, movies,
  anime, documentaries and more – on thousands of internet-connected devices.
  
  You can watch as much as you want, whenever you want, without a single ad – all for one low
  monthly price. There's always something new to discover, and new TV shows and movies are added
  every week!
* ### How much does Netflix cost?
  
  New members can try 30 days of Netflix for ₹0. After the free trial ends, your plan will
  automatically renew at the regular price depending on the plan you select. Plans range from ₹149
  to ₹649.
  
  Watch Netflix on your smartphone, tablet, Smart TV, laptop or streaming device. No extra costs,
  cancel at anytime.
* ### Where can I watch?
  
  Watch anywhere, anytime. Sign in with your Netflix account to watch instantly on the web at
  netflix.com from your personal computer or on any internet-connected device that offers the
  Netflix app, including smart TVs, smartphones, tablets, streaming media players and game consoles.
  
  You can also download your favourite shows with the iOS or Android app. Use downloads to watch
  while you're on the go and without an internet connection. Take Netflix with you anywhere.
* ### How do I cancel?
  
  Netflix is flexible. You can easily cancel your account online in two clicks. There are no
  cancellation fees – start or stop your account anytime.
* ### What can I watch on Netflix?
  
  Netflix has an extensive library of feature films, documentaries, shows, anime, award-winning
  Netflix originals, and more. Watch as much as you want, anytime you want.
* ### Is Netflix good for kids?
  
  The Netflix Kids experience is included in your membership to give parents control while kids
  enjoy family-friendly TV shows and films in their own space.
  
  Kids profiles come with PIN-protected parental controls that let you restrict the maturity rating
  of content kids can watch and block specific titles you don’t want kids to see.

## Discover companies that are most similar to your best clients with AI

Oppwiser's AI Lookalike Company Finder feature helps businesses discover accounts that closely match
their best clients. Focus your sales reps on accounts that are most likely to buy and improve sales
pipeline velocity.

[Learn more][17]

## Search for the top players in any niche or market with AI

Ditch limiting and clunky industry filters when researching companies. Use free text search to map
out players in any industry, market, or niche. Additionally, apply advanced firmographic or keyword
filters to pinpoint the companies that matter most.

[Learn more][18]

## Map your Target Addressable Market in seconds

Opportunity Scanner will continuously scan a database of 60M+ companies and score each company based
on its similarity to your existing clients or best prospects. Easily uncover net new accounts or
identify high-intent lookalike accounts that may be buried in your CRM.

[Learn more][19]

## Spot buying and technographic signals within job offers, company, and employee data

Track any signal, technology, or keyword within job offers, public company data, and employee work
experience. Uncover technology stacks, company, and work environment trends that you might be able
to address with your offering or by tailoring your outreach.

[Learn more][20]

## Get in touch with the right decision makers

Utilize a database of 150 million work emails and 10 million direct dials to connect with the buyers
that matter most. Filter contacts by their work experience, education, location, and other data
points.

[Learn more][21]
[500x500]

## Verified contact data

The deliverability of our email data is verified publicly as well as using SMTP check. All emails
are marked as either valid or catch-all to identify if they are safe to send emails to.

    [Silvent - patented air technology][Silvent - patented air technology]
    
    Our air nozzles, air knives and air blow guns are designed to reduce sound levels and improve
    the efficiency of blowing with compressed air.
    
    [SILVENT X07 air nozzle in stainless steel isolated with no background.]
    
    Blowing with compressed air is common in industry when cleaning, drying, cooling, sorting or
    transporting objects. Silvent air nozzles are used in fixed installations and make efficient use
    of compressed air. All Silvent air nozzles feature the optimal combination of high blowing
    force, low energy consumption and low noise levels.
    
    [SILVENT 384 W-S air knife in stainless steel isolated with no background.]
    
    Air knives are most commonly used to blow away liquids, grime, airborne debris, etc. from
    surfaces or objects. Silvent air knives create a broad and effective flow of air that produces a
    pneumatic scraping effect without mechanical contact. All Silvent air knives feature the optimal
    combination of high blowing force, low energy consumption and low noise levels.
    
    [SILVENT Pro One air blow gun isolated with no background.]
    
    Manual blowing with compressed air is common in industry when cleaning, drying or cooling
    objects. Silvent air blow guns make efficient use of compressed air. All Silvent air blow guns
    feature the optimal combination of high blowing force, low energy consumption and low noise
    levels, at the same time as they are ergonomically designed for professional use.
    
    [SILVENT 767-L high force air blow gun isolated with no background.]
    
    Some industries and processes need more blowing force than a regular air blow gun can generate.
    Therefore, Silvent has developed air blow guns with high blowing force. The blowing force ranges
    from twice as strong up to 30 times stronger than a regular air blow gun. All Silvent air blow
    guns are safe, quiet and efficient, and are developed for professional use.
    
    [SILVENT pneumatic muffler SIS-03 isolated with no background.]
    
    The noise from compressed air valves is extremely hazardous, but equipping valve discharge ports
    with pneumatic mufflers often causes operational disturbances. Silvent pneumatic mufflers have
    integrated warning indicators. The technology basically entails that the pneumatic muffler
    itself sets the optimal combination of flow capacity and noise suppression thanks to the dynamic
    internal filter, which subsequently minimizes operational disturbances and eliminates clogging.
    
    [SILVENT adjustable swivel PSK-14 isolated with no background.][SILVENT adjustable swivel PSK-14
    isolated with no background.]
    
    To optimize blowing, it is sometimes necessary to be able to make pressure or blowing angle
    adjustments, for example. In other cases protection against airborne debris may be needed.
    Silvent has different types of accessories for easily performing various blowing tasks,
    optimally and safely.

* [Our Products][2]
  * [Air Nozzles][3]

    [Silvent - patented air technology][Silvent - patented air technology]
    
    Our air nozzles, air knives and air blow guns are designed to reduce sound levels and improve
    the efficiency of blowing with compressed air.
    
    [SILVENT X07 air nozzle in stainless steel isolated with no background.]
    
    Blowing with compressed air is common in industry when cleaning, drying, cooling, sorting or
    transporting objects. Silvent air nozzles are used in fixed installations and make efficient use
    of compressed air. All Silvent air nozzles feature the optimal combination of high blowing
    force, low energy consumption and low noise levels.
    
    [SILVENT 384 W-S air knife in stainless steel isolated with no background.]
    
    Air knives are most commonly used to blow away liquids, grime, airborne debris, etc. from
    surfaces or objects. Silvent air knives create a broad and effective flow of air that produces a
    pneumatic scraping effect without mechanical contact. All Silvent air knives feature the optimal
    combination of high blowing force, low energy consumption and low noise levels.
    
    [SILVENT Pro One air blow gun isolated with no background.]
    
    Manual blowing with compressed air is common in industry when cleaning, drying or cooling
    objects. Silvent air blow guns make efficient use of compressed air. All Silvent air blow guns
    feature the optimal combination of high blowing force, low energy consumption and low noise
    levels, at the same time as they are ergonomically designed for professional use.
    
    [SILVENT 767-L high force air blow gun isolated with no background.]
    
    Some industries and processes need more blowing force than a regular air blow gun can generate.
    Therefore, Silvent has developed air blow guns with high blowing force. The blowing force ranges
    from twice as strong up to 30 times stronger than a regular air blow gun. All Silvent air blow
    guns are safe, quiet and efficient, and are developed for professional use.
    
    [SILVENT pneumatic muffler SIS-03 isolated with no background.]
    
    The noise from compressed air valves is extremely hazardous, but equipping valve discharge ports
    with pneumatic mufflers often causes operational disturbances. Silvent pneumatic mufflers have
    integrated warning indicators. The technology basically entails that the pneumatic muffler
    itself sets the optimal combination of flow capacity and noise suppression thanks to the dynamic
    internal filter, which subsequently minimizes operational disturbances and eliminates clogging.
    
    [SILVENT adjustable swivel PSK-14 isolated with no background.][SILVENT adjustable swivel PSK-14
    isolated with no background.]
    
    To optimize blowing, it is sometimes necessary to be able to make pressure or blowing angle
    adjustments, for example. In other cases protection against airborne debris may be needed.
    Silvent has different types of accessories for easily performing various blowing tasks,
    optimally and safely.
